summary.text: Nick Kupper is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 25, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Kupper grew up in Oregon, joined the U.S. Air Force in 2003 and spent 20 years as a military electrician, recruiter and manager before retiring in 2023 while stationed at Luke Air Force Base.
The profile says Kupper has degrees in human resource management and aviation maintenance technology, was working as a paralegal, and has four children with Crystal.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 25 (candidate-submitted statements)
